how: Each flagged row re-opened on Google Maps (English UI, one lookup at a time) with its own map query and its local name; the place's address was compared with the row. 'Permanently closed' on this very place, or 'Temporarily closed' with no reopening date → removed; a seasonal closure → kept with a season note; one web search for the temporary ones. A town that fell under its minimums got a replacement confirmed open on Maps.

rows.name: Cloud 9
rows.evidence: Google Maps 2026-11-24: 'Cloud9 Gourmet Burger and Milk Bar', Clock Tower Chang Lam SE, Thimphu (the row's place) shows 'Temporarily closed', no hours; the only other Cloud 9 is a karaoke pub. No reopening date found.

Not already in the library.
